criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: HealthIA combines exactly-five adaptive clinical question blocks with a Google ADK coordinator that executes the minimum current-state tools, a patient-owned longitudinal record, multimodal identification/extraction for laboratory reports and clinical imaging/report formats, a provenance-linked clinical twin, and conversational retrieval that can return to an older requested study instead of blindly using the latest result. The workflow is event-driven rather than timer-driven and preserves the original evidence before interpretation. The remaining utility gap is one judge-visible Taskmaster mission that reaches a verified external/synthetic outcome and closes its mission state.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: The system has typed longitudinal state, deterministic safety, patient control/audit, guarded Gemini calls, a real Google ADK per-request planning bridge over the authorized PatientState, event-driven SSE UI, no permanent server/browser polling loop, single-use pairing codes, patient/device/connection-bound HMAC credentials with restart-safe Secret Manager support, atomic result-plus-original evidence commits, Firestore state, patient-scoped Cloud Storage evidence, Cloud Run provisioning and a strict cloud proof gate. Remaining architecture risk is authenticated multi-patient application identity/isolation and the absence of an actual Cloud trace proving the configured deployment path end to end.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: A clean hosted runner has installed Chromium and repeatedly passed the Python suite, fourteen full API/state workflows, real-browser E2E, compilation, smoke, Judge Ω, JavaScript and PowerShell syntax, deterministic release ZIP verification and a second pytest run from the extracted release. Cloud tooling defines a fail-closed proof for Cloud Run + Firestore + GCS + live Gemini + Google ADK trajectory + restart-safe device identity + multimodal extraction + clinical-twin round-trip. A GitHub Actions probe has also demonstrated the current external blocker: no supported GCP Project ID/authentication secret is configured, so no Cloud mutation was attempted. There is still no authenticated Cloud proof artifact, final video or complete judge package.

critical_blockers.statement: Device credentials are signed, patient/device/connection bound and unit-tested across a simulated restart, but authenticated multi-patient application isolation and restart behavior in real Cloud Run remain unproven.
